title: PullTransaction

transactionId.description: This is the unique M-PESA transaction ID.

trxDate.description: This is a timestamp that represents the date and time that the transaction was completed

msisdn.description: This is the number of the customer who made the payment.

transactiontype.description: The Type of the transaction made by the customer

billreference.description: This is the account number for which the customer is making the payment. This is only applicable to Customer PayBill Transactions

amount.description: This is the Amount that was transacted

organizationname.description: The name of your Organization used on go-live

description: A transaction returned by the pull query.
